# KSRTC Radio

> KSRTC Radio (ആനവണ്ടി) is an independent online nostalgia experience inspired by Kerala KSRTC bus journeys.

## Website
https://ksrtcradio.online/

## About
KSRTC Radio combines Malayalam music, bus ambience, engine sounds and rain experiences to recreate the atmosphere of travelling through Kerala by bus.

## Creator
Benson Thomas

- Kerala KSRTC
- ആനവണ്ടി
